title: Solar Site Survey Inspection Checklist Form
subtitle: An original solar site survey workflow that guides a bounded inspection from readiness through findings and release, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete solar site survey inspection checklist form for the proposed photovoltaic site that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when an assigned inspector must confirm safe observation boundaries, document domain-specific conditions, route deficiencies, and record a qualified acceptance, restriction, or follow-up decision. The survey coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Solar site survey inspection identity and authority
sections.guidance: Define the asset, inspection scope, qualified reviewer, and conditions before observations begin.

sections.title: Solar site survey readiness and safe observation boundary
sections.guidance: Confirm identity, operating context, access, and limits before checking condition.

fields.label: Roof plane or ground area ID

blocks.label: Stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This record does not authorize roof access, structural conclusions, or contact with electrical components. Stop the survey when access, weather, damaged components, exposed conductors, or structural conditions are unsafe. Keep unqualified people clear and route the condition to the site's qualified electrical, structural, or safety reviewer.

sections.title: Solar site survey inspection points and finding evidence
sections.guidance: Check each point only when observed; use the findings table for condition, evidence, and disposition.

blocks.label: Domain inspection checklist
items: Safe observation point established without stepping onto an unapproved roof
Roof covering, flashing, drainage, and visible deterioration documented
Rafters, trusses, or available structural references identified for review
Parapets, drains, vents, skylights, and rooftop equipment mapped
Shade sources and representative solar-access observations recorded
Ground slope, erosion, vehicle access, and subsurface conflicts noted
Meter, service disconnect, main panel, and rating labels photographed from safe access
Potential inverter, disconnect, and rapid-shutdown equipment areas identified
Potential conduit path and penetrations documented without invasive work
Fire access, property boundaries, easements, and customer constraints noted
Weather, roof moisture, loose components, and fall exposure reassessed
All unknown structural and electrical conditions routed to qualified reviewers

fields.label: Inaccessible areas, sampling limits, representative conditions, trends, and supporting context

sections.title: Solar site survey exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Unprotected roof edge, unstable ladder, or unsafe access
Wet, damaged, loose, or storm-affected roof or PV components
Exposed conductors, open electrical parts, arcing, or burn marks
Structural movement, severe deterioration, or falling-object exposure
High wind, lightning, ice, heat, or other unsafe weather
Unknown energized equipment or damaged wiring pathway
Blocked emergency access or uncontrolled public exposure
Any condition beyond the surveyor's authorization or training
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This record does not authorize roof access, structural conclusions, or contact with electrical components. Stop the survey when access, weather, damaged components, exposed conductors, or structural conditions are unsafe. Keep unqualified people clear and route the condition to the site's qualified electrical, structural, or safety reviewer.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each inspection exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Solar site survey decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Proposed photovoltaic site identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
